description: This file manages matrix migration snapshots, including loading markers, resolving paths, checking for pending or actionable migrations, and creating backup snapshots with associated metadata.

classes.name: MatrixMigrationSnapshotMarker
classes.description: Type representing metadata marker for matrix migration snapshot

classes.name: MatrixMigrationSnapshotResult
classes.description: Type representing the result of creating a migration snapshot

methods.name: loadSnapshotMarker
methods.description: Loads and validates a migration snapshot marker from a file

methods.name: resolveMatrixMigrationSnapshotMarkerPath
methods.description: Resolves the file path for the migration snapshot marker

methods.name: resolveMatrixMigrationSnapshotOutputDir
methods.description: Resolves the output directory for migration snapshots

methods.name: hasPendingMatrixMigration
methods.description: Checks if there are pending matrix migrations based on legacy state or crypto detection

methods.name: hasActionableMatrixMigration
methods.description: Checks if there are actionable matrix migrations that can be performed

methods.name: maybeCreateMatrixMigrationSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a migration snapshot backup if needed and returns its details
